regime_thresholds.unit: nM thapsigargin (up to 1000 nM / 1 uM tolerated by Rnlsmut)
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: Wild-type beta cells survive only below 50 nM thapsigargin.
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: Wild-type beta cells undergo massive PERK/IRE1a/CHOP/TXNIP/Caspase-3 apoptosis above 50 nM TG, whereas Rnlsmut beta cells withstand 20-fold higher TG concentrations (1,000 nM in NIT-1 and 5,000 nM in human SC-beta cells).

regime_thresholds.unit: 2-hour pulses of 10 ng/mL IFN-gamma separated by 24h rest
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: Single 2h pulse produces only transient PD-L1 expression that decays within days
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: 3x 2h pulses establish persistent ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility at CD274/IRF9/JUNB/JUND for >7 days while avoiding chronic 12h+ STAT1/IRF1 toxicity

regime_thresholds.parameter_name: Stage 7 Culture Duration for Physiological Glucose Threshold
regime_thresholds.unit: weeks in Stage 7 Full medium (ZM447439 + NAC + T3)
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: At S7w0, SC-islets fail to respond to 16.7 mM glucose; at S7w2, SC-islets secrete insulin at an unphysiologically low glucose threshold of ~3 mM (EC50 = 5.6 mM), risking hypoglycemia.
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: At S7w3 to S7w6, SC-islets acquire the adult human glucose threshold of ~5 mM glucose (EC50 = 6.7 mM at S7w3 and 8.1 mM at S7w6) and yield 2-fold higher in vivo C-peptide achieving the 4.5 mM human glycemic set point.

regime_thresholds.parameter_name: SA-FasL Microgel Stoichiometry and Local Residence Window
regime_thresholds.unit: PEG microgels per 1 IEQ (delivering 1 ug SA-FasL per 1,000 microgels; 3.0-day local half-life, cleared from serum by days 7-14)
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: Without SA-FasL on the microgels, 100% of grafts reject at a mean of 27.7 days despite identical rapamycin trough levels.
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: A 7-14 day local presentation of SA-FasL at 2 microgels:1 IEQ establishes a self-sustaining FoxP3+ Treg niche that persists >6 months.

regime_thresholds.parameter_name: Surface CD47 Receptor Density on B2M-/- CIITA-/- Human Islet Cells
regime_thresholds.unit: CD47 molecules per cell (range 180,000-220,000; achieved at lentiviral VCN >= 2)
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: Rapid missing-self lysis and granzyme B/perforin degranulation by IL-2-activated primary human NK cells and macrophages.
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: Complete protection from primary human NK cells and macrophages in vitro and in vivo (>600,000 molecules/cell achieved in HIP iPSC-islets).
